ios.desc:
The simplest way to calculate currency even when you’re on airplane mode.

Why you’ll love it

Works 100% offline – skip roaming fees and spot‑ty Wi‑Fi.

Real‑time accuracy – rates auto‑refresh hourly when you’re back online.

Built‑in calculator – add, subtract, and convert in one tap.

All the money you need – from USD & EUR to Bitcoin, Ethereum, and more.

Lightning search – find any currency by name, code, or country.

Tiny footprint – fast download, low storage.

No sign‑up

Travel smarter
Save favorite currencies for instant access.

Crypto‑ready
Track popular coins alongside traditional money in the same clean interface.
